title: Precise vanishing for maps from a truncated bounded projective complex
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], let $P^\bullet$ be a bounded complex of projective objects with $P^i=0$ for $i<n$, and let $K^\bullet$ be a complex such that $H^i(K^\bullet)=0$ for every $i\ge n$. Then every morphism from $Q(P^\bullet)$ to $Q(K^\bullet)$ in the derived category $D(\mathcal A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] is zero, where $Q$ is the localization functor at quasi-isomorphisms.

proof.text: By the bounded-above projective-complex comparison in [lem-pc-ring-derived-map-representative], the canonical localization map identifies morphisms from $P^\bullet$ in the homotopy category with morphisms from $Q(P^\bullet)$ in $D(\mathcal A)$. Thus it is enough to prove that every homotopy-class morphism $P^\bullet\to K^\bullet$ is zero.

source.place: Tag 064D proof, first equality via Tag 064B (lemma-morphisms-from-projective-complex)

proof.text: Represent the canonical truncation triangle [lem-sf-derived-truncation-triangle] at the bound $n$ by the standard truncation complexes $\tau_{\le n-1}K^\bullet\to K^\bullet\to\tau_{\ge n}K^\bullet\to$. The hypothesis $H^i(K^\bullet)=0$ for every $i\ge n$ makes the upper truncation acyclic, while the lower truncation is zero in degrees $i\ge n$. Applying the homological functor $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(Q(P^\bullet),-)$ to this distinguished triangle, using [lem-weil-pbc-hom-into-triangle-exact], and then the comparison bijection of Step 1, reduces the desired vanishing to the two homotopy-category groups $\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal A)}(P^\bullet,\tau_{\le n-1}K^\bullet)$ and $\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal A)}(P^\bullet,\tau_{\ge n}K^\bullet)$.

source.place: Tag 064D proof, truncation triangle and reduction by Lemma 0149 (lemma-representable-homological)

proof.text: For the concrete standard truncations in Step 2, every chain map $P^\bullet\to\tau_{\le n-1}K^\bullet$ is zero degreewise: $P^i=0$ for $i<n$, and $\tau_{\le n-1}K^\bullet{}^i=0$ for $i\ge n$. Thus $\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal A)}(P^\bullet,\tau_{\le n-1}K^\bullet)=0$. The upper truncation is acyclic by Step 2, so [lem-pc-ring-projective-into-acyclic-zero] makes every map $P^\bullet\to\tau_{\ge n}K^\bullet$ homotopic to zero. The exact Hom sequence from [lem-weil-pbc-hom-into-triangle-exact] then gives $\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal A)}(P^\bullet,K^\bullet)=0$, and Step 1 gives the asserted derived-category vanishing.

lean.statement: theorem precise_vanishing (A : Type u) [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A] (P K : CochainComplex A ℤ) (n : ℤ) (hPbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, (∀ i : ℤ, i < a → IsZero (P.X i)) ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, b < i → IsZero (P.X i))) (hPprojective : ∀ i : ℤ, Projective (P.X i)) (hPtruncated : ∀ i : ℤ, i < n → IsZero (P.X i)) (hKvanishing : ∀ i : ℤ, n ≤ i → IsZero (K.homology i)) : ∀ f : (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q.obj K), f = 0
